edit.description: Earlier robust response to large residuals, then baseline curvature; not a tolerance radius
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: The primary endpoint affinity does not improve relative to the tested incumbent, or the decoded final affinity is unobserved, in which case the curvature-timing edit is not credited.

The landmark_00_soft_mass mid-window plateau does not separate from the early/late baseline under independent batches, or strong_sign_conflicts rises above the observed 1, so the adopted coherent coordinate is not a stable control target.

The landmark_00_local_dx peak/trough positions or the landmark_00_local_dz late-window decline are not reproducible across independent batches (observed 9 and 7 strong sign conflicts respectively), so the adopted dx/dz contrasts are batch artifacts.
Strain or structural validity degrades even if affinity is unchanged or improved; these are reported separately and can veto the edit.
The compiled C1 table does not actually change the executed trace (no realized change in the reward schedule), in which case the edit is reported as ineffective rather than credited.
rationale: Adopt H001, H002 and H003, each backed by its delivered curve handle: landmark_00_soft_mass (Eef4385e476674774) is the most batch-coherent observable (whole_window_z=+0.64, 4 sign changes, 1 strong sign conflict) with a positive mid-window plateau, while landmark_00_local_dx (E4bbe368c52deda38) and landmark_00_local_dz (E4aac9dffddd0d59f) show reproducible but noisier non-monotone and late-window-negative structure. The clock observation (E0857891f4effbfe1) fixes the learning window at [0.0,0.5] with recorded affinities removed and an equal score prior, so no decoded-affinity evidence exists to relate these coordinate contrasts to final affinity. Because the coherent soft-mass excursion and the dx/dz contrasts are concentrated in the early-to-mid window and decay late, the registered reward-lane recipe C1_robust_to_base (delta 0.5 -> 0.75 -> 1.0 over knots [0,0.5,1], dose fixed at 1, blend 0) is the offered choice that applies the tighter curvature early, when the observed contrasts are strongest, and relaxes toward baseline curvature late, when the curves decay toward zero. This is a reward-route curvature-timing hypothesis only; it changes no temperature, teacher set, dose or model binding, and it is not an estimate of an optimal guidance dose.
